snippet.title: A Thousand Cloys - Gameplay trailer
snippet.description:
A Thousand Cloys is an incremental game about exploring and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

Check it out on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3861740/A_Thousand_Cloys/
Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4140860/A_Thousand_Cloys_Demo/
Browser demo on Itch.io: https://grhyll.itch.io/a-thousand-cloys-demo
